title: Noisy blue and lime gradient
description: Flat matte blue-to-lime light falloff with super-fine photographic grain, revised without image references.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE complete high-resolution wide 16:9 landscape background for an independent magazine's editorial design. No image references. Numeric palette only: blue #007EBD and brighter blue #168DDD must dominate, with luminous yellow-lime #D6FF62. Use soft optical color transitions and broad quiet compositional space. All content must remain fully abstract and nonrepresentational. This is a finished background only, for typography or a separate editorial card to be added later.
NO text, letters, logos, symbols, interface, mockup, frame, border, collage, contact sheet, recognizable objects, landscape, horizon, fields, sky, cloud shapes, water, leaves, or scenery. No sharp geometric contours, visible circles, hard-edged blobs, splatter, thick brush marks, metallic highlights, or neon-tech effects. In particular: NO glass, simulated frosting, pebbled surfaces, embossed texture, droplets, ripples, relief, cellular texture, or surface highlights. The picture plane must be FLAT and MATTE.

Specific medium: a sophisticated matte color-field magazine-cover background with a super-fine, flat photographic grain. Broad, asymmetrical light falloff moves from saturated blue across the upper-left and central two-thirds toward luminous lime at the lower-right outer edge, with very small cool-ivory traces in the blending region. The falloff is one soft continuous optical diffusion, gently irregular rather than a rigid straight gradient or circular spotlight. Keep a spacious calm blue center. The grain is extremely fine, even, delicate film noise: no large particles, no material pattern, no paint surface, no stippled edges, no visible paper fibers, and no texture with apparent height. No glass or frosted texture whatsoever. Completely matte, almost smooth at normal viewing size, with subtle analog life visible only up close.
revisionNote: Revised without image references to distinguish the material from frosted glass. Original PNG preserved.

title: Editorial cover / Blue + lime
description: Oversized ivory typography on soft blue atmosphere, with a restrained lime accent. Editorial exploration for review.
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE portrait 4:5 editorial social cover for Recoup, not a mockup. A culturally confident independent music publication cover: huge crisp type sitting directly on an atmospheric background. The typography is the unmistakable foreground and stays extremely readable at phone size. No UI cards, frame, border, interface, additional logo, icon, body copy, footer, photograph, person, music clipart, or invented text. Do not reproduce any text from input references.
COMPOSITION, fixed across comparison: portrait 4:5, generous 8% left and right margins. Small tracked monospaced label at upper left, exactly 'RECOUP / INSIGHTS', positioned 8% from top. Headline starts around 25% from top, set flush left across exactly three lines, with tight expressive but legible tracking and compact leading. Set a bold DM Sans-like contemporary grotesk sans-serif, clean letterforms with confident weight, maximum size that fits the longest line inside the margins. Exact headline text and linebreaks:
AI & the
business
of music.
Nothing else is written anywhere. Keep all main letters entirely inside the canvas, not cropped. Text must be perfectly sharp against the softer background. Let broad empty atmosphere occupy the lower fifth so the composition can breathe. Entire image is final flat cover artwork, not shown on a wall or device.
COLOR AND ATMOSPHERE: blue and lime treatment. Use input images only as background color/texture references, particularly their rich sky blue #007EBD, pale ice-blue diffusion, fine analog spray grain, and lime #D6FF62 at the edges. Build a new quiet portrait composition, deep enough blue behind the complete headline for excellent ivory contrast. Background should have gently drifting blurred blue bands and a diffuse lime glow emerging only in the bottom-right corner, never a literal field, cloud, landscape, foliage or discernible object. Delicate irregular photographic noise, no heavy splatter or harsh halftone. Main headline warm ivory #F8FAF5, with only the ampersand on its first line in vivid lime. Top label also lime, small and subordinate. No drop shadows on type. This is editorial typography in sharp focus layered over soft abstract atmosphere.
